selection.reason: Highest combined_score among correct native archive entries; no held-out performance used.
selection.source_review: Selected and parent are pure arithmetic over relative_fitness_drop, default_radius, swarm_diameter; no imports, files, random seeds, latent state, benchmark access, or evaluator calls.

variants.no_compactness: Exact native parent: deletes only compactness-floor addition; tests that specific mechanism.
variants.fixed_response: Investigator control fixes radius_scale=2.0 and fraction=0.60 to the selected compactness floors, with reevaluate and retained velocity; asks if observation dependence adds value over a constant response. No tuning.

selection.suite_access_disclosure: A readiness audit agent inspected the existing suite configuration before this freeze. No held-out outcome existed, no mutations were made, and root selected by native search score and defined controls from source without viewing held-out cases. Freeze precedes comparison execution and runner suite load.
selection.model_route: No new model mutations or paid API calls needed: original native search target already completed.

freeze_stage: before comparison suite load or execution
candidate_interface: choose_response(observation) only; source inspection required because execution is not sandboxed
